IMPRESSIVE FIVE-BEDROOM DETACHED FAMILY RESIDENCE ON AN ELEVATED LANDSCAPED SITE WITH PANORAMIC COUNTRYSIDE VIEWS, DETACHED GARAGE AND EXCEPTIONAL FAMILY ACCOMMODATION

Smith Property proudly present to the market this outstanding detached family residence occupying a magnificent elevated site in the peaceful townland of Carn, Ballyjamesduff, Co. Cavan. Extending to approximately 260 sq.m. (2,840 sq.ft.), this beautifully maintained home enjoys breathtaking panoramic views across the rolling drumlin landscape of East Cavan towards Lough Sheelin, whilst offering privacy, generous family accommodation and an exceptional standard of presentation throughout.

Approached through electric entrance gates, a sweeping tarmacadam driveway winds through beautifully landscaped mature gardens, immediately creating an impressive sense of arrival. The home is perfectly positioned to maximise its elevated setting, with every principal reception room designed to capture the spectacular countryside views that surround the property.

Constructed with an attractive low-maintenance brick façade, the residence offers timeless appeal, combining quality craftsmanship with practical family living.

Stepping inside, a bright and welcoming entrance hallway sets the tone for the accommodation that follows. To the front, the principal living room is an elegant family space enjoying wonderful views over the manicured gardens and surrounding countryside. A feature solid fuel stove creates a warm focal point, complemented by decorative ceiling coving and generous proportions, making this an ideal room for relaxing or entertaining.

To the rear of the home lies the heart of the property a spacious open-plan kitchen and dining area fitted with an extensive range of built-in cabinetry and integrated appliances, enhanced by recessed lighting and excellent workspace. The adjoining utility room provides additional storage, a second sink, dedicated laundry facilities and direct access to the rear garden.

Double doors from the kitchen lead seamlessly into what is undoubtedly one of the home`s standout features a magnificent sitting room and sunroom. Centred around an impressive natural stone fireplace with solid fuel stove, this beautiful room is flooded with natural light from windows on three sides, perfectly framing the panoramic countryside views. Double patio doors open directly onto a sheltered, sun-soaked patio, creating an effortless connection between indoor and outdoor living and providing the perfect setting for family gatherings, outdoor dining or simply enjoying the peaceful surroundings.

The ground floor sleeping accommodation comprises four generously proportioned double bedrooms, each bedroom is beautifully presented and offers ample space for a range of bedroom furniture, creating comfortable and practical accommodation for every member of the household. The master suite is particularly impressive, featuring a beautiful bay window that perfectly frames the picturesque gardens and rolling countryside beyond, creating a wonderful space to wake up to each morning. The room is further complemented by a stylish fully tiled en-suite shower room.

The first floor provides exceptional flexibility for modern family living. One side of the landing leads to a stunning guest bedroom featuring recessed lighting, a beautiful panoramic bay window overlooking the surrounding countryside, together with its own luxurious en-suite incorporating a raised feature bath and separate shower.

On the opposite side lies an exceptionally large multi-purpose room currently utilised as a home gym. This versatile space could equally serve as a home office, cinema room, games room, children`s playroom or additional living accommodation depending on a purchaser`s requirements. With uninterrupted countryside views from every angle, it offers an inspiring environment whether working from home or simply enjoying the remarkable setting.

Externally, the property continues to impress. Beautifully landscaped mature gardens surround the home, while the extensive sun-trapped patio creates a wonderfully private outdoor entertaining area linking the house to the detached garage. The detached garage offers excellent storage, secure parking, workshop space or further potential to suit a variety of uses.

Set in the peaceful townland of Carn, just outside Ballyjamesduff, this exceptional home enjoys an elevated setting with panoramic views across the rolling drumlin countryside of County Cavan.

The name Carn, derived from the Irish word for cairn or ancient stone monument, reflects the area`s deep historical roots and long-standing connection to the landscape. From this tranquil setting, the ever-changing views stretch across patchwork fields, gentle hills and distant horizons, creating a sense of space and tranquillity that is increasingly difficult to find.

Whether enjoying a morning coffee as the sun rises across the valley or relaxing on the patio as evening light settles over the countryside, the setting is every bit as impressive as the home itself.

Properties of this calibre, occupying such spectacular sites while offering turnkey accommodation, privacy and exceptional family living, are rarely presented to the market. This is a truly special home that must be viewed to be fully appreciated.
